Travel Notice for Pet Guests

Travelers, please note that companion animal care is being kept steady and simple across the network, with extra attention on calm handling and clear directions for every trip.

At Port Isolde, <<FACT F003>> If you are connecting onward, please keep your pet close, use the posted pet lounge signs, and follow the usual check-in guidance from our staff.

At Merrowgate, <<FACT F023>> Please also note <<FACT F017>> Bring water, a leash, and any approved supplies, and give yourself a little extra room for comfort.

If you need help with planning, health paperwork, or pet relief access, please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
